name: What is the best bathroom layout for a small ADU?

mainEntity.name: How do you fit a full bathroom into a very small ADU without making it feel cramped?
mainEntity.text: How do you fit a full bathroom into a very small ADU without making it feel cramped?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best layout for a small ADU bathroom is one that keeps plumbing simple while preserving usable floor space. A common approach is to put the shower, vanity, and toilet along one wall or around a single wet zone so the contractor does not have to run multiple long branches. A pocket door can free up space that a swing door would take, and a corner or neo-angle shower can make the room feel less crowded. Wall-mounted vanities, recessed medicine cabinets, and shallow storage also help. In a compact ADU, the bathroom should be planned with circulation in mind so the door does not collide with the toilet or vanity. It is also worth checking how the bathroom relates to the bedroom and kitchen, since a better layout can improve privacy and reduce noise. Many small ADUs work best when the bathroom is designed before the rest of the floor plan, not as an afterthought. That usually produces a cleaner, cheaper, and more livable unit.
